value.rationale: A naturally occurring contiguous data-erasure model changes a canonical stable rational interpolation operator by an explicit, monotone sharp amplification factor, and moves all worst-case evaluation positions to the hole midpoint. Exact norm coefficients and localization are independently useful for stability assessment, and are not implied by generic order-of-growth bounds.
